rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: ProShares Ultra Gold (2x Gold Bullion)
positions.catalyst: July Employment Situation (NFP) lands TODAY 8:30am ET — consensus +83k, unemployment 4.2%, but leading indicators skew soft: ADP printed just +44k vs +75k expected, and Goldman flags July NFP historically misses with downward prior revisions (June was +57k; Apr/May revised -74k combined). A soft print reinforces Fed rate-cut pricing → lower real yields + weaker USD = tailwind for gold. Gold is already having its strongest week since January (~,250/oz, 7-week high) on the same weak-labor repricing plus falling energy (Hormuz ceasefire hopes cutting inflation risk). UGL is the 2x-bullion expression; entered here because gold BULLION is only modestly up pre-market (GLD +1.8%, UGL +3.5%) — NOT extended — whereas the leveraged gold MINERS gapped +8% to +12% pre-market (NUGT +8.3%, JNUG +8.1%, GDXU +12%), tripping the no-chase rule.
positions.driver: LONG UGL, 2x gold, 100% capital. Asymmetric macro catalyst with a directional lean: two of three NFP outcomes favor gold — a dovish-soft print (base case given ADP/revision trend) lifts gold via rate-cut repricing, and a very-soft/risk-off print lifts gold as a safe haven; only a HOT surprise (low-probability tail) reverses it. 2x leverage is matched to a genuine fresh catalyst (today's jobs print + confirmed dovish gold trend), while deliberately AVOIDING the far-more-extended 2x/3x leveraged miners (up 8-12% pre-market — chasing). Chose UGL over: NUGT/GDXU (overextended gaps, chase-rule fail); GLD/GLDM (1x — lower asymmetric payoff for the same thesis); SOXL 3x semis (+4.6% pre-market but two-sided into NFP at record-high equity valuations, no semis-specific fresh catalyst); staying in spot BTC (range-bound chop, no fresh catalyst today). Entry 50.23 = Robinhood real-time pre-market last (11:43:32Z, bid 50.23/ask 50.25) — the dashboard proxy still shows the prior regular-session close (48.53) pre-open because Yahoo does not stream pre-market for this ETF; the 50.23 live quote will match the dashboard feed once the session opens. Stop 46.21 (-8%, matched to 2x leverage).
positions.risks: Binary event risk: a HOT NFP or hawkish wage surprise reverses the gold rally, and 2x leverage amplifies the drop; gold is already extended after its strongest week since January, so an in-line/priced-in print offers limited fresh upside (buy-the-rumor/sell-the-news). A continued risk-on equity melt-up would mean gold underperforms a 3x equity long (opportunity cost). Pre-market ETF liquidity is thinner than at the open, so the 50.23 fill assumes a limit near the pre-market mid. Mitigants: -8% hard stop caps loss; gold's dual-sided asymmetry (rises on BOTH dovish and risk-off outcomes) is the structural downside protection; chose bullion (UGL) over the far-more-extended leveraged miners; daily rotation limits the hold to ~24h.
